name: steps
title: Steps
description: Where a reader is in a short sequence.
use: A checkout, a setup or another task of a few named steps done in order. Mark only the current step with aria-current="step": the steps before it are drawn complete and the steps after it wait. Keep a horizontal row to four or five short titles.

instead.when: The amount done is a number, not a list of named steps
The entries are events that already happened
The reader may open the sections in any order
The list is the path of parent pages
The reader ticks the items off

classes.name: steps
classes.description: The list of steps, on an ol. A CSS counter numbers the markers and a line joins each marker to the next

classes.name: steps-vertical
classes.description: One step under another, for a narrow column or steps that carry a sentence each

classes.name: steps-complete
classes.description: Every step is complete; no step is current

classes.name: steps-item
classes.description: A step, on an li. Its marker is a number in a well while it waits, and an ink disc with a check once the current step comes after it

classes.name: steps-body
classes.description: Wraps the title and the description of a step that has both

classes.name: steps-title
classes.description: The name of a step, on one line; it wraps in a vertical list

classes.name: steps-description
classes.description: A quiet line under the title

states.name: current
states.description: The marker rises as a small sheet with an ink contour, and the steps before this one are drawn complete

example:
1. Account
  2. Billing
  3. Confirm
